updates.quote: We are clear about adding between 18 MM to 20 MM customers to the franchise in FY27.
I would say probably between 26%, 27% growth we should deliver now on a full year basis.
ROA for the quarter came in at 4.6%
We are well on track to deliver 180-odd agentic applications and 600-odd agents for the year.
we remain quite clear about ending the year with close to 2,800 on stand-alone gold branches.
We remain pretty comfortable place to deliver a 25 to 40 basis point improvement in FY27 on opex-to-NTI.

new_promises.statement: Expect to deliver between 60 million to 62 million new loans in FY27.
new_promises.quote: We are well on track to deliver between 60 million to 62 million new loans in FY27.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Sustain a 15% to 18% fee income growth.
new_promises.quote: we should be able to sustain a 15% to 18% fee income growth is what I would just say to you, Viral.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Maintain medium-term AUM growth guidance of 20% to 25%.
new_promises.quote: medium term, we maintain a guidance of 20% to 25% on a year lower here and a year higher there.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain
